components.name: Avatar
components.purpose: User profile picture with fallback to initials when no image is provided

components.name: AvatarGroup
components.purpose: Sub-component of Avatar.

components.name: Badge
components.purpose: Small status indicator or numeric count overlay attached to another element

components.name: Button
components.purpose: Trigger for user actions; renders as `<button>` or `<a>` depending on context

components.name: ButtonGroup
components.purpose: Related actions kept together: Undo / Redo, zoom out / in, Cancel / Save

components.name: Calendar
components.purpose: A month of days to choose one date or a range; the base for DatePicker and DateRangePicker

components.name: Checkbox
components.purpose: Single boolean selection with an associated label; supports indeterminate state

components.name: Combobox
components.purpose: One value from a long list, found by typing: a country, a town, a person

components.name: DatePicker
components.purpose: A date typed or picked from a calendar: delivery dates, bookings, deadlines

components.name: DateRangePicker
components.purpose: A start and an end date: a stay, a report period, leave

components.name: Divider
components.purpose: A line that separates groups of content, horizontally or vertically

components.name: Field
components.purpose: Label, hint and error for any control, wired the way Input wires its own

components.name: FileUpload
components.purpose: Pick files by button or by dragging them in, see what's chosen, and remove any

components.name: Heading
components.purpose: Semantic heading element (H1–H5 visual sizes, any `<h1>`–`<h6>` tag) with a visual size decoupled from its document-outline level

components.name: IconButton
components.purpose: An action shown only as an icon, for toolbars, cards and dense rows

components.name: Input
components.purpose: Labelled single-line text entry with hint and error states

components.name: InputAddon
components.purpose: Sub-component of InputGroup.

components.name: InputGroup
components.purpose: An Input joined to the text and buttons that belong to it: "https://", "kr.", an Apply button

components.name: Kbd
components.purpose: A key the user presses, drawn as a keycap

components.name: Label
components.purpose: Standalone form label element — used when a label must be decoupled from its input

components.name: Link
components.purpose: Navigation to another page or resource; use Link for navigation and Button for actions

components.name: MultiSelect
components.purpose: Several values from a long list, found by typing: skills, reviewers, languages

components.name: NumberInput
components.purpose: A number typed or stepped: a quantity, an amount, a percentage

components.name: OtpInput
components.purpose: A short code sent by text or email, shown as one box per character

components.name: ProgressBar
components.purpose: Shows how far a task has got, or that it's running when the end isn't known

components.name: Radio
components.purpose: Single-selection control within a mutually exclusive group

components.name: Search
components.purpose: A site or list search: a search landmark with Enter to search, Escape to clear and an optional shortcut

components.name: SegmentedControl
components.purpose: One choice from a few, shown side by side: a view switch, a time range

components.name: Select
components.purpose: Dropdown for choosing a single value from a list; supports grouped options

components.name: Skeleton
components.purpose: Placeholder loading state that mirrors the geometry of the content it replaces

components.name: SkipLink
components.purpose: First Tab stop on the page that lets keyboard users jump past the header to the main content

components.name: Slider
components.purpose: One value from a range, by dragging or with the keyboard: volume, a price limit, opacity

components.name: Spinner
components.purpose: Indeterminate loading indicator for in-progress operations

components.name: Switch
components.purpose: Binary toggle for on/off settings; renders as a styled checkbox under the hood

components.name: Tag
components.purpose: A short label on content: a category, a status word, a chosen value; optionally removable or clickable

components.name: TagInput
components.purpose: Free-text values as tags: keywords, email addresses, ingredients

components.name: Textarea
components.purpose: Multi-line text entry with label, hint, and error states — mirrors Input API

components.name: TimePicker
components.purpose: One time of day: an appointment, a delivery slot, opening hours

components.name: ToggleButton
components.purpose: A button that stays on or off, like bold in an editor or a grid overlay

components.name: VisuallyHidden
components.purpose: Text screen readers announce but sighted users don't see

components.name: Alert
components.purpose: Contextual inline feedback message with semantic severity levels (info, success, warning, error)

components.name: AlertDialog
components.purpose: Confirmation gate for an action the user must explicitly accept or decline — real `alertdialog` role, no outside-click/close-button dismiss, unlike Dialog

components.name: BaseSheet
components.purpose: Unstyled overlay sheet primitive used internally by Drawer — not consumed directly

components.name: Card
components.purpose: Compound container for grouped content — composed from named sub-components

components.name: CardBody
components.purpose: Sub-component of Card.

components.name: CardDescription
components.purpose: Sub-component of Card.

components.name: CardFooter
components.purpose: Sub-component of Card.

components.name: CardHeader
components.purpose: Sub-component of Card.

components.name: CardMedia
components.purpose: Sub-component of Card.

components.name: CardTitle
components.purpose: Sub-component of Card.

components.name: ContextMenu
components.purpose: The actions for one thing, opened where the pointer is: a file row, a card, a canvas

components.name: Dialog
components.purpose: Overlay for tasks or information requiring focused attention

components.name: Drawer
components.purpose: Side-anchored slide-in panel for supplemental content or secondary navigation

components.name: HoverCard
components.purpose: A preview of what a link leads to: a person's profile, a page's summary

components.name: HoverCardContent
components.purpose: Sub-component of HoverCard.

components.name: HoverCardTrigger
components.purpose: Sub-component of HoverCard.

components.name: Menu
components.purpose: Dropdown list of actions opened from a trigger: account menus, overflow ("more") menus, row actions

components.name: NavigationMenu
components.purpose: The site's header navigation: top-level links, plus groups that open a dropdown of links. Hidden below 1024px, where SideNav's drawer carries the same links (its `headerItems`)

components.name: Popover
components.purpose: Content shown next to its trigger without blocking the page: a filter panel, a date picker, a short form

components.name: PopoverAnchor
components.purpose: Sub-component of Popover.

components.name: PopoverClose
components.purpose: Sub-component of Popover.

components.name: PopoverContent
components.purpose: Sub-component of Popover.

components.name: PopoverTrigger
components.purpose: Sub-component of Popover.

components.name: ThemeScope
components.purpose: Gives one part of a page its own brand, mode, or both; overlays opened inside it (Dialog, Drawer, AlertDialog, Menu, Select, Tooltip) take the same, although they render at the end of the page

components.name: Toast
components.purpose: Ephemeral notification pushed to a corner of the viewport; auto-dismisses after a timeout

components.name: Tooltip
components.purpose: Contextual label revealed on hover or focus — supplements an icon or truncated text

components.name: TooltipProvider
components.purpose: Sub-component of Tooltip.

components.name: Accordion
components.purpose: Collapsible content sections with animated expand/collapse; supports single or multi-open modes

components.name: AccordionContent
components.purpose: Sub-component of Accordion.

components.name: AccordionItem
components.purpose: Sub-component of Accordion.

components.name: AccordionTrigger
components.purpose: Sub-component of Accordion.

components.name: Breadcrumb
components.purpose: Hierarchical page location trail; the last item is the current page (non-linked)

components.name: Carousel
components.purpose: A row of slides shown a few at a time, moved with buttons, dots, swipe or arrow keys

components.name: CarouselSlide
components.purpose: Sub-component of Carousel.

components.name: DataTable
components.purpose: Sortable, filterable, paginated table for structured datasets

components.name: EmptyState
components.purpose: Placeholder for zero-content states — icon, heading, supporting text, and an optional action

components.name: FormActions
components.purpose: Sub-component of FormLayout.

components.name: FormErrorSummary
components.purpose: Sub-component of FormLayout.

components.name: FormLayout
components.purpose: The frame of a form: spacing, sections, rows, actions, and an error summary after a failed submit

components.name: FormRow
components.purpose: Sub-component of FormLayout.

components.name: FormSection
components.purpose: Sub-component of FormLayout.

components.name: Hero
components.purpose: Page-level section header with eyebrow, title, lead text, and an action slot

components.name: Pagination
components.purpose: Page navigation controls for multi-page data sets; exposes current page and total page count

components.name: SideNav
components.purpose: Section navigation: inline beside the content (240px wide) from 1024px up; below that, in a left Drawer opened by `SideNavTrigger`, which hides itself from 1024px up. Wrap both in `SideNavProvider`

components.name: SideNavProvider
components.purpose: Sub-component of SideNav.

components.name: SideNavTrigger
components.purpose: Sub-component of SideNav.

components.name: Stepper
components.purpose: Where someone is in a process with a fixed order: checkout, sign-up, an application

components.name: Table
components.purpose: Static data table with semantic header, body, and row structure

components.name: TableBody
components.purpose: Sub-component of Table.

components.name: TableCaption
components.purpose: Sub-component of Table.

components.name: TableCell
components.purpose: Sub-component of Table.

components.name: TableFoot
components.purpose: Sub-component of Table.

components.name: TableHead
components.purpose: Sub-component of Table.

components.name: TableHeader
components.purpose: Sub-component of Table.

components.name: TableOfContents
components.purpose: The sections of a long page as links, with the one being read marked: docs, articles, policies

components.name: TableRow
components.purpose: Sub-component of Table.

components.name: Tabs
components.purpose: Segmented view switcher with full keyboard navigation; built on Radix Tabs

components.name: TabsContent
components.purpose: Sub-component of Tabs.

components.name: TabsList
components.purpose: Sub-component of Tabs.

components.name: TabsTrigger
components.purpose: Sub-component of Tabs.

components.name: Toolbar
components.purpose: A row of controls for one area: the formatting buttons over an editor, the actions over a table or canvas

components.name: ToolbarSeparator
components.purpose: Sub-component of Toolbar.

components.name: ToolbarSpacer
components.purpose: Sub-component of Toolbar.
